comparison.objective: Replace a printer toner cartridge and close the printer door.
comparison.physical_skill: Large keyed extraction/insertion along guide rails and notches while avoiding a transfer roller.
comparison.success_condition: Old cartridge safely outside, new one seated within 4 mm/2°, door shut, robot clear, stable for 1 s; movement, contact, drop, or tilt hazards fail.
comparison.reason: Tests guided consumable exchange and hazard avoidance, with no controlled break-off operation or loose-fragment collection.
